scoring_justification: Full recompute of extracted modulus from raw simulation data infeasible because raw P‑h data CSV is not a guaranteed output; checker validates reported modulus against paper gold and checks internal consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold elastic modulus from COMSOL validation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig. 3(d): mean fitted modulus from COMSOL simulated indentation is 107.1 GPa
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: paper‑reported value, verified against the source

schema.description: Scored artifact with extracted modulus from plateau fitting and percentage error relative to 103 GPa.

outputs.description: Validated extracted elastic modulus and its error against the known input modulus of the COMSOL simulation.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the agent's reported extracted_modulus and percentage_error against hidden reference values and tolerances derived from the paper's COMSOL validation outcome. The exact gold values and tolerances are not disclosed in this public contract.
